from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        stack.append((yy,xx))
            miny = min(y for y,x in cells)
            maxy = max(y for y,x in cells)
            minx = min(x for y,x in cells)
            maxx = max(x for y,x in cells)
            shape = {(y-miny,x-minx) for y,x in cells}
            bh, bw = maxy-miny+1, maxx-minx+1
            frame = all((y,x) in shape for y in range(bh) for x in range(bw)
                        if y == 0 or y == bh-1 or x == 0 or x == bw-1)
            objects.append({'cells': cells, 'shape': shape, 'y': miny, 'x': minx,
                            'bh': bh, 'bw': bw, 'color': color, 'frame': frame})
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for is_frame in (True, False):
        group = [o for o in objects if o['frame'] == is_frame]
        # Preserve the existing vertical order while compacting frames up and crosses down.
        group.sort(key=lambda o: (o['y'], o['x']) if is_frame else (-o['y'], o['x']))
        placed = []
        for o in group:
            candidates = range(0, h-o['bh']+1) if is_frame else range(h-o['bh'], -1, -1)
            chosen = None
            for top in candidates:
                coords = {(top+dy, o['x']+dx) for dy,dx in o['shape']}
                if all(not (coords & p) for p in placed):
                    chosen = coords
                    placed.append(coords)
                    break
            if chosen is None:
                chosen = {(o['y']+dy, o['x']+dx) for dy,dx in o['shape']}
            for y,x in chosen:
                out[y][x] = o['color']
    return out
'''
